comments.author: @HiddenEnginesExplained
comments.text: The opening fruit example captures a subtle problem: two people can want to trade and still have their goods become available at different times. Finance has to coordinate timing, not just represent value. That timing gap appears in card payments too: “approved” and “paid to the merchant” are different stages. I trace that everyday example on my channel.
